scope: Corollary 2.3 of the manuscript “A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model” (preprints/A-PD4-group-without-an-aspherical-manifold-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ccbbf7f15686b6f7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The map π1S → H is onto. If r = rank H, then H1(S; Z) → H1(P; Z) is an isomorphism and H2(S; Z) ∼ = Zr.
